Yes—I can help with exchanges, including multiple items in the same delivered order.

First, I need to authenticate you. Please send **your account email**.

Also, please share:
1) your **order id** (it looks like `#W0000000`)  
2) the **two items** you want to exchange (any details from your packing slip are fine—item names/model)

Once I have that, I’ll verify the order is **delivered** and that the exchanges are for the **same product types** with the requested option changes (clicky switches; Google Home compatibility).

I actually don’t remember which email I used for the order, but I do have my order number: it’s #W2378156.

From my packing slip, the two items I want to exchange are:
- Mechanical Keyboard (full size, RGB backlight, but I want it with clicky switches instead of whatever switches it came with)
- Smart Thermostat (currently for Apple HomeKit, but I need one that works with Google Home)

Let me know if you need any other info to look up my order!

Thanks—order **#W2378156** helps.

Before I can make any changes, I have to authenticate your identity. Please reply with **either**:

- **Your email address** used for the order, **or**
- Your **first name, last name, and ZIP code**

Once I’ve authenticated you, I’ll look up **#W2378156** and confirm it’s **delivered**, then we can set up the two exchanges:
1) Mechanical Keyboard → same model with **clicky switches**
2) Smart Thermostat → same product line with **Google Home** compatibility (instead of Apple HomeKit)

If you can also paste the **item IDs** from your packing slip (if shown), that would speed things up, but it’s optional—I can try to locate them from the order details after authentication.
Sure! My name is Yusuf Rossi and my ZIP code is 19122. Let me know if you need anything else to verify my order.
